scope: Node committed preconditions, revision ordering, follower results and heartbeat monitor retries
coverage: Reject stale same-Node writes before any state, revision or watch changes
Independent-key writes with identical author revisions receive ordered commit revisions
Exact retry preserves revision and watch event count
Forward a rejected Node proposal through a real loopback follower RPC and return node-conflict
Convert application conflict to Kubernetes HTTP 409
POST and PUT Node HTTP responses report the committed revision
Committed readiness parsing is independent of replica wall time; explicit monitor expiry changes readiness
Failed apply file persistence does not consume the commit revision
Heartbeat monitor continues through conflict and unavailable consensus ticks
limitations: Legacy v1 deltas remain readable; all members must run the updated implementation for v2 precondition guarantees
Cross-Node identity and network claim uniqueness at apply is tracked by podster-ucm.2.6
No general cross-resource atomicity or power-loss proof
Production startup WAL recovery, streamed store artifacts and automatic compaction remain open
Focused suites only; full suite failures tracked separately
